comment: Avoid her. She never thoroughly explains what she wants from you in essays and yet kills you when she grades them. You ask for help, she helps you, but she still doesn't grade fairly. She isn't very organized when you come to class and if you don't share her point of view she  won't like you. We had 3 essays, 1 group project, and a research paper.
avoid her at all costs. hard grader with no explanation. never prepared.
Shes not really ever prepared for class, and we never really discussed anything from the book that was on the tests in class either.  Avoid her, this should be an easy class but she makes it bad.
really easy teacher, but classroom lecture is boring. just do the readings and you will do fine. interesting assignments. she also cancels class or postpones readings a few times a semester
Easy and fairly interesting class. There would be quizzes nearly every week on the readings, and class time would be spent watch movies or having class discussions.
Very placid teacher, plods through every class without enthusiasm. This is the absolute easiest class in the world if u are adept at spouting meaningless but emotive nonsense.
Very clear in her expectations, assignments were interesting.
Very rigid in her expectations, never showed much excitement on the subjects she taught, was not helpful at all.

The class provides you with a lot of amazing texts and articles.  The teacher provides you with an opportunity to talk about the articles in class.  If you read and talk, you do well.  That's it.  Everyone should try to take her class.
